personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK structure with 7 Dark-First Utility precision and 3 Editorial typography
personality_one_liner: An intellectual, dark-mode command center that feels like a premium, modern stoic OS—precise, calm, and deeply organized.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm for editorial feel. Sharp horizontal alignment. Avoid boxing everything in cards; use edge-to-edge layouts with subtle borders.

do's: Use heavy frosted glass on sticky headers, tab bars, and the Command Palette (Cmd+K) overlay.
Pair blur with a translucent tinted base (75% opacity of surface) for readability.
dont's: Never blur body content or list rows.
Do not use glass for text inputs or standard buttons.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A calm daily overview (Activity, Quick Capture, and Shortcuts).

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner in Antique Gold.
states.empty: N/A - Dashboard is never empty, shows welcome widgets.
states.error: Subtle text notice with a retry button.

screens.layout: Header with 'ARETÉ' wordmark (serif) and minimal glass effect. Top section: Quick Capture input (styled as a seamless block, not a heavy card). Below: 'Activity History' list with hairline dividers (no cards). Focus on typography and vertical flow.

screens.name: KnowledgeBase
screens.purpose: Index of all pages, folders, and tags (Quartier Général/Bibliothèque).

states.empty: Stoic marble bust illustration + 'Your library is empty. Start writing.'

screens.layout: Search bar at the top. Edge-to-edge list of knowledge pages. Rows use subtle padding and a right chevron. Grouped by tags or recent. No outer borders or heavy cards, just elegant dividers.

screens.name: KnowledgePage
screens.purpose: The core editor and reader view with bidirectional linking.

states.empty: Blank canvas with 'Type to start, [[ for links, / for commands'.

screens.layout: Clean, distraction-free reading/writing view. Massive serif title at the top. Body text in Geist. Wiki-links [[Page]] highlighted in brandPrimary. At the bottom: a distinct 'Backlinks Panel' showing pages that reference this one.

screens.name: CommandPalette
screens.purpose: Global quick-action overlay (Cmd+K equivalent) for search, navigation, and creation.

states.empty: List of default commands (Create Page, Go to Dashboard).

screens.layout: Triggered via floating FAB or header icon. Full-screen frosted glass overlay. Large, seamless input field at the top. List of instant search results and commands below. Extremely fast, keyboard-focused.

hero_empty_state.alt: Dark marble bust of a stoic statue, conveying intellectual depth

section_background.alt: Minimalist gold geometric lines on a dark background for tactical precision

instructions_to_main_agent: Design an intellectual, dark-mode personal OS. Avoid generic SaaS 'cards' completely. Use edge-to-edge layouts with subtle 1px dividers to separate content.
Implement the 'Wiki-style Bidirectional Links' visually. Any text in [[Brackets]] should be styled with brandPrimary color and be pressable.
The Knowledge Page must have a 'Backlinks Panel' at the bottom of the content. This is non-negotiable for a knowledge base.
Build a Command Palette overlay (Cmd+K equivalent). Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet or a full-screen glass modal with a seamless search input. It should feel instantaneous and highly technical.
Follow the color palette strictly: #0C0C0E (obsidian canvas) with #C8A97E (Antique Gold) accents. No purples, no blues.
Typography is critical: Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for large, imposing titles and 'Geist' for perfectly readable, modern body text and UI labels.
Use the provided stoic marble statue image as the primary empty state visual for the Knowledge Base, applying a heavy dark gradient scrim over it so it blends into the background.
Include a 'Quick Capture' input block directly on the Dashboard for immediate thought logging.
